questions.explanation: \(2y^{1/2}\): a variable has a fractional exponent (it sits under a root), so it cannot be written as P(x)/Q(x).

questions.prompt: Without long division, find the remainder when \(3 x^{3} + 7 x^{2} + 8 x - 3\) is divided by \(x+1\).
questions.explanation: Divisor \(x+1\) gives \(x=-1\). The remainder \(p(-1)=-7\) is the alternating sum of the coefficients: no division needed.

questions.prompt: Divide \(2 t^{3} - 5 t^{2} + 5 t + 3\) by \(t - 1\). Find the quotient. (The remainder is \(5\).)
questions.explanation: Long division: divide leading terms, multiply the whole divisor, subtract, repeat. The quotient is \(2 t^{2} - 3 t + 2\) and the remainder is \(5\). Check: \((t - 1)(2 t^{2} - 3 t + 2)+5=2 t^{3} - 5 t^{2} + 5 t + 3\).

questions.prompt: The polynomial \(3 k + x^{4} + 3 x^{3} + 2 x^{2} - x\) leaves remainder \(8\) when divided by \(x - 1\). Find \(k\).
